description: UICA's ST-84 recoilless rifle, a versatile and powerful anti-material weapon for infantry use.  Suitable for those too cheap to buy heavy energy weapons.  Still, it remains generally effective.

variants.description: UICA's ST-84 recoilless rifle, a versatile and powerful anti-material weapon for infantry use.  Suitable for those too cheap to buy heavy energy weapons.  Still, it remains generally effective.
A crudely adapted launcher that originally belonged to an assault gunship.  Should be capable of firing 84x246mm rounds.
